source: Live network observation via Claude-in-Chrome MCP on bonsall browser
scope: PDP (lawn-garden sprayer/mister), /stores/ home, /products/lawn-garden/ PLP. Auth-walled flows (cart, checkout, account) NOT observed.

classification_legend.TERMINATE: Canary Go gateway answers this — storefront calls our spine for the data
classification_legend.FORWARD: Vendor or Murdoch's existing service still owns this — gateway proxies
classification_legend.REPLACE: Murdoch's owns today; we'd swap implementation but preserve contract during migration
classification_legend.KEEP: Tracking/analytics/marketing — leave alone, not in our spine's domain

endpoints.purpose: Search engine, faceted browse, recommendations, behavioral tracking
endpoints.rationale: Constructor.io is Murdoch's contracted search/discovery vendor. Their indexing of catalog data would need to ingest from our spine post-migration, but the runtime API stays vendor-managed.

endpoints.purpose: Bot detection, fingerprint scoring, session validation
endpoints.rationale: Vendor-managed security layer. Independent of catalog/inventory.

endpoints.purpose: Email/lifecycle personalization rules (e.g. 'Get 10% Off' floating CTA, browse-abandonment triggers)
Lifecycle activity tracking (page views, browse signals)

Unknown. Custom Murdoch's-built service running in AWS App Runner (us-west-2). Hostname is anonymous/random, suggests internal-only. POST events, returns 503 — possibly deliberate (fire-and-forget event ingest with empty body response).
endpoints.rationale: First-party service of unknown purpose. If it's behavioral telemetry, our spine's observability covers it. If it's an order/loyalty/wallet service, would need investigation. Worth chasing — the AWS App Runner anonymous hostname is the only first-party Murdoch's-branded API surface I observed.
endpoints.open_question: What does this service actually do? Single endpoint observed, anonymous host, response 503. Could be a health probe, telemetry sink, or something more material. Recommend deeper investigation.

endpoints.purpose: Google Maps JS for the store-locator dialog map view
Google Analytics 4 page/event tracking + Google Merchant Center conversion
endpoints.key_intel: GA4 view_item event leaks pr1=idFOGR_190424 — vendor/manufacturer code, distinct from JSON-LD's POS SKU 9390357. Confirms dual-keyed item master.

endpoints.purpose: Programmatic ad networks, retargeting, conversion attribution

endpoints.endpoint: Store list (no XHR — embedded in HTML)
endpoints.purpose: All 47 stores embedded as JS object literal in /stores/ page. No store-list API exists in the request stream — it's pure SSR.
endpoints.rationale: Canary Go owns store master. Even though Murdoch's serves it via SSR (not XHR), our spine becomes the source of truth. Their Episerver template fetches from us at render time.

endpoints.purpose: Real-time per-store inventory check for the SKU on a PDP, drives the 'Find in a Murdoch's store' workflow
endpoints.evidence: inferred (workflow exists in UI; XHR did not surface in network monitor — possible service-worker interception or full-page nav model)
endpoints.rationale: Inventory authority shifts to Canary Go spine. Module D + Module S join. Critical to capture in a follow-up session — currently the highest-value first-party API and we don't have a packet on it yet.

endpoints.purpose: Add to cart, modify cart, checkout init
endpoints.rationale: Cart is a transactional surface tied to checkout/payment flow. Out of Canary Go scope (Counterpoint owns transactional). Forward.

endpoints.purpose: Constructor.io ingests Murdoch's catalog for search indexing
endpoints.rationale: Today the catalog feed presumably comes from Murdoch's Episerver/PIM. Post-migration, the feed source becomes our Canary Go catalog API. Constructor.io stays the runtime.

open_questions: What is mbzaubiphz.us-west-2.awsapprunner.com? Anonymous AWS App Runner service. Single observed endpoint. Could be telemetry, loyalty, or something material.
Inventory-by-store API contract: not captured this session. Need a follow-up where we open the store-locator dialog, type a zip, click Find, and inspect the network panel manually.
Reviews: page is wired for reviews ('0 stars / Write a review' visible) but no review XHR observed. Likely BazaarVoice or PowerReviews. Worth confirming.
BOPIS fulfillment: 'SHIP IT' button + 'Find in a Murdoch's store' link on PDP. Two-fulfillment model confirmed but logic flow not captured.
Cart persistence: anonymous vs. logged-in cookie behavior unobserved.
MAP pricing: window.clickToViewPriceCuratedProduct global suggests some SKUs hide price until click. Logic and trigger unobserved.
